claims.claim_ar: استثناء بـ«إِلَّا» يحصر اتّباع أكثرهم في الظنّ فقط (إِلَّا ظَنًّا)، فيقرّ القارئ أن ما يتبعه الأكثرون محصور في الظنّ لا غير.
claims.claim_en: An exceptive/limiting construction (hasr/qasr) with 'إِلَّا' confines what most follow to 'conjecture' only (إِلَّا ظَنًّا), indicating that the majority follow nothing beyond mere conjecture.
claims.needs_review_reason: The ayah contains the explicit phrase «إِلَّا ظَنًّا», but the available commentary chunk contains discussion of 'ظن' (e.g. «بدل من ظنوا») rather than reproducing the exact exception phrase; linkage to the exception device is inferred from the ayah rather than directly quoted in the chunk.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Narrows and diminishes the status of popular belief, portraying it as merely conjectural and therefore unreliable against truth.

claims.claim_ar: تضادّ تعريف/تنكير بين «الظَّنَّ» (معرفة) و«شَيْئًا» (نكرة) في «لَا يُغْنِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ شَيْئًا»؛ فيؤكّد أن هذا الظنّ المحدّد لا يعطي شيئًا من الحقّ العامّ.
claims.claim_en: A definiteness/indefiniteness contrast (tarif/tankir): 'الظَّنَّ' (definite) versus 'شَيْئًا' (indefinite) in 'لا يُغْنِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ شَيْئًا', which reinforces that that particular conjecture yields nothing whatsoever of the truth.
claims.needs_review_reason: The commentary chunk discusses 'الظن' (e.g. «والظن للهلاك»), but does not explicitly analyze the definiteness/indefiniteness contrast; the rhetorical reading is a standard stylistic observation applied to the ayah and supported indirectly by the chunk's focus on 'ظن'.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Highlights the futility of conjecture by juxtaposing the definite concept of 'the conjecture' with the indefinite 'anything', thus stressing total ineffectuality.

claims.claim_ar: تكرار أداة التوكيد/الافتتاح «إِنَّ» (وجودها مرّتين) يُحدث تكرارًا تكبيريًا وتوكيديًا في سياق الكلام، فيؤكّد نفاذ الحقيقة مقابل الظنّ.
claims.claim_en: Repetition (takrār): the doubled use of the emphatic particle 'إِنَّ' creates a reinforcing, emphatic rhythm, strengthening the contrast between conjecture and truth.
claims.needs_review_reason: The claim points to the repetition of «إِنَّ» in the verse itself; the provided commentary uses formulæ like «فإن قلت:» illustrating rhetorical «إن/إنّ» usages but does not quote the two «إِنَّ» of the ayah directly. Evidence is therefore indirect and should be confirmed against texts with exact orthography/diacritics.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Creates emphasis and rhythmic reinforcement, making the denial of the efficacy of conjecture more forceful before the concluding divine attribute.
